title: Classroom of the Elite
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kiyotaka Ayanokouji enters an elite government high school that promises freedom and near-guaranteed futures, but students are ranked by class and points, and only the best are rewarded. Placed in the scorned Class D after deliberately underperforming on his entrance exam, he works quietly alongside Suzune Horikita, who is determined to climb to Class A, in a school of ruthless competition.
life_message: In a system that rewards only results, intelligence and strategy decide who rises; the series questions what that does to people.
